notes: Compiled from public sources. A completion date is shown only where the cited source states one; otherwise it stays blank rather than being guessed.

projects.name: Indore Metro — Yellow Line
projects.summary: About 17–18 km and 16 stations in service. The 6 km priority corridor opened on 31 May 2025; the 11 km Reach II extension opened on 5 September 2026, taking the network to 16 stations.

projects.name: Indore Metro — Airport extension
projects.summary: The remaining 15.2 km and 13 stations of the Yellow Line are under construction. No public completion date is currently stated.

projects.name: Indore–Ujjain Metro
projects.summary: Public reporting says the Indore–Ujjain line will be taken up only after Simhastha 2028. No construction start or completion date has been notified.

projects.name: Indore Ring Road
projects.summary: Ring Road segments and bridges are mapped in OpenStreetMap under construction. The mapped extent is not an official project schedule; see the mapped sites below.
